retrievalProfile.description: A multi-row filmstrip layout featuring sequential action shots against a graffiti backdrop, topped with heavy, high-contrast display typography.
triggerTerms: bold yellow display type on blue

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, three-tiered horizontal grid of 35mm filmstrip frames containing sequential action photography of dancers in a graffiti-covered room, set against a textured blue background with large-scale, compressed yellow and white typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Three horizontal filmstrip rows acting as the primary structural grid
High-contrast yellow display text dominating the upper third
Repetitive sequential action photography creating a sense of motion
Vibrant graffiti textures within the small frames contrasting with the solid blue background
coreInvariants: Black filmstrip borders with white sprocket holes and technical edge markings

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography occupies the top 30%; three equal-height filmstrip rows occupy the remaining 70%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright yellow title text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right reading of the title, followed by a downward scan through the sequential film frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the layout is packed with information, using the blue background as a framing device.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Royal blue background providing a deep base for the composition.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary display text to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary text and filmstrip sprocket details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors (blue and yellow) paired with high-contrast black and white film elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, ultra-compressed sans-serif and wide, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extremely tight tracking and vertical elongation.
Secondary title uses wide, extended horizontal proportions with rounded corners.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'b' and 'd' in the main title have flat, squared-off bowls to fit the compressed grid.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: pairing an ultra-compressed vertical font with an ultra-extended horizontal font.
graphicDevices: Filmstrip borders with technical text like 'KODAK SAFETY FILM'

preserve: The vertical compression of the main title
The horizontal extension of the secondary title
avoid: Overlapping the text onto the filmstrip frames

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, compressed verticality of the main title.
Matches the wide, geometric, 80s-tech feel of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a royal blue textured background with three horizontal rows of black 35mm filmstrips. Each filmstrip should contain 5-6 frames showing sequential breakdancing moves in a room with colorful graffiti walls. Leave the top third of the image blue for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-compressed yellow lowercase sans-serif text at the top. Below it, add a line of wide, extended white uppercase sans-serif text with small red arrows between the words.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct rows of filmstrips?
Is the main title yellow and vertically compressed?
Are there red arrows between the words in the white subtitle?
Does the photography inside the frames feature graffiti backgrounds?

adjustableVariables: Subject matter within the film frames
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos or trademarks
Specific faces of the individuals in the photos

mustAchieve: Authentic 35mm filmstrip aesthetic with sprocket holes
Clear typographic hierarchy between compressed and extended fonts

postGenerationChecks: Check that the filmstrip sprocket holes are white and evenly spaced.
Ensure the yellow text is significantly taller than it is wide.
Verify the red arrows are placed horizontally between the white words.
Confirm the background texture is a solid, slightly distressed blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a solid color background, add multiple horizontal filmstrip overlays with sequential action shots, and top with high-contrast, width-distorted sans-serif typography.
